name: Tropical Fruit Platter
instructions: 1. Thoroughly wash all fresh fruits under cold running water.
2. Peel the pineapple, papaya, and mango, removing any seeds or hard cores.
3. Cut all fruits into uniform, bite-sized cubes or wedges.
4. Arrange the fruits decoratively on a platter to showcase the vibrant colors.
5. In a small bowl, mix the black salt, roasted cumin powder, and a pinch of chili powder.
6. Drizzle fresh lime juice over the fruit platter just before serving.
7. Sprinkle the prepared spice mix evenly over the fruit to elevate the flavor profile.
description: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are rich in tropical biodiversity. This platter celebrates the bounty of the islands' fertile soil, offering a refreshing and healthy treat that highlights the unique, sweet flavor profiles of local fruits, traditionally spiced to provide a perfect balance of savory and sweet flavors typical of island hospitality.
